ext k
  simp only [physicalFrozenCenteredCoefficient,analyzingCoefficient,WithLp.ofLp_toLp]
  change ((↑(P.length j*P.width):ℂ)⁻¹)*
    (∫ z, g z k*starRingEnd ℂ
      (if |v z-t| ≤ a*(2:ℝ)^j.val then b j (orig j l) k t*(Q).physicalPacket t j l u k z else 0)
      ∂volume.prod volume) = _
  have hp (z : ℝ×ℝ) : (Q).physicalPacket t j l u k z =
      P.physicalPacket t j (orig j l) u k z := congrArg
        (fun f : SchwartzMap (ℝ×ℝ) ℂ => f z)
        (P.referenceFamily_physicalPacket t t R cone w F hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency j l u k)
  congr 1
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with z
  exact congrArg (fun f : ℂ => g z k*starRingEnd ℂ
    (if |v z-t| ≤ a*(2:ℝ)^j.val then b j (orig j l) k t*f else 0)) (hp z)
findings.problem: The proof manually transports packet equality through evaluation, the integrand, and almost-everywhere integral congruence. The existing packet equality can instead be rewritten directly under the integral binder.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace the proof with:
by
  ext k
  simp only [physicalFrozenCenteredCoefficient, analyzingCoefficient, WithLp.ofLp_toLp]
  simp_rw [P.referenceFamily_physicalPacket t t R cone w F hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency]
findings.benefit: Keeps the mathematical idea explicit—retained physical packets are unchanged—while removing the auxiliary pointwise equality and measure-theoretic plumbing. This adds no integrability assumptions and remains valid for arbitrary a and empty κ.
